weeks.content:
Understanding technology and digital devices. Types:
cameras. Computer types: desktop, laptop, tablet.
Basic parts: monitor, keyboard, mouse, CPU. Uses in
daily life. Care and handling of devices. Computer
lab safety rules.

weeks.topic: History of Digital Devices generations: vacuum tubes, transistors, integrated
weeks.content:
Evolution from abacus to modern computers. Five
circuits, microprocessors, AI. Key inventors: Charles
Babbage, Ada Lovelace. Changes in size, speed, and
cost over time.

Hardware vs Software basics. Input devices:
keyboard, mouse, microphone, scanner, webcam.
Output devices: monitor, printer, speakers,
headphones. Functions of each device. Proper use
and care.

weeks.content:
Internal parts: CPU (brain), RAM (temporary
Motherboard (connects everything). Power supply
and cooling systems. How parts work together.

Definition: external devices connected to computer.
Common peripherals: printer, scanner, external hard
drive, USB flash drive, webcam, speakers.
Connecting devices using USB, HDMI, Bluetooth.
Uses of each peripheral device.

Detailed study of input devices. Keyboard:
QWERTY layout, typing practice, special keys.
Mouse: left/right click, scroll, drag and drop.
Touchpad and touchscreen. Microphone for voice
input. Scanner for documents and images.

Detailed study of output devices. Monitor: displaying
information, screen resolution. Printer: types (inkjet,
laser), printing documents. Speakers and
headphones: audio output. Projector for
presentations.
